facts.value: Following an overview of general machine learning methods and applications, the goal is to provide students with an understanding of the basic principles, methods and application domains for evolutionary computation.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Science in Computer Systems

facts.value: Students will be introduced to a broad range of evolutionary computation techniques including genetic algorithms, genetic programming, and grammatical evolution.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Science in Computer Systems

facts.value: Different representational mechanisms including binary, Gray, real-valued and e-code will be discussed.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Science in Computer Systems

facts.value: Different approaches to the mutation and recombination operators will be presented.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Science in Computer Systems

facts.value: Fitness function types and interactive evolutionary computation will be introduced.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Science in Computer Systems

facts.value: Depending on the particular expertise of the lecture involved in delivery of the module particular emphasis may be placed on application to areas such as neuroevolution, evolutionary robotics (including evolutionary humanoid robotics), automatic program synthesis, the parallelisation of sequential programs, and financial modelling and prediction.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Science in Computer Systems

facts.value: Potential societal, ethical and philosophical implications of advanced AI/ML technologies will be outlined.
